svg.title: Not-So-Smart Thermostat, slide 2
svg.desc: Mina Sparks works at her sticker-covered laptop beside Token while four playful text-free doodle bursts—spark, tangled knot, gears, and confetti—spill from the laptop. She says, ‘There… we… go. I connected the thermostat to Token. Now you can just ask him to change it to whatever you want!’ A cable and separate cyan signal show Token connected to the thermostat.

g.data-exact-copy: I connected the thermostat to Token. Now you can just ask him to change it to whatever you want!
g.text: Now you can just ask him
